metadata.description: Turn a requirement or intent into a playbook every agent session continues from: requirement interview saved to the requirements file → plan → approval → work tracked from git, with every file kept consistent by a ripple sweep. Add your own skills on events — e.g. to mirror progress to an issue tracker.
